item_short_desc: Rothco’s Pen and Knife Combo doubles as both a pen and a knife! The alloy steel blade is completely hidden at the opposite side of the pen point. The blade length of the knife measure 2 ½” and is covered by the copper pen cap. The overall length of this tactical pen is approximately 5 5/8”, perfect to keep hidden away in your pocket.
